user.title: Manual Water Meter
user.description: Add a water meter you read by hand.

data_description.reminder_days: How often you want to be reminded to take a new reading.
How often you want to be reminded to take a new reading.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Import a water consumption history from a CSV of absolute meter readings. Data is written as long-term statistics so it appears in the Energy dashboard.

filename.name: File
filename.description: Path to a CSV file, e.g. /config/water_history.csv. Relative paths are resolved under the config directory.

csv.name: CSV content
csv.description: CSV content pasted inline, with columns date,reading and an optional price (meter value in m³, price per m³).

price.name: Fallback price
price.description: Price per m³ used for cost when the CSV has no price column. Ignored if a price column is present.

update_current.name: Update current reading
update_current.description: Also set the meter's current reading and cost to the last values found in the CSV.
